remarks: Nestled on a quiet street in Norwalk's desirable Spring Hill neighborhood, this charming Cape Cod/Colonial offers 1,583 sq ft of comfortable living space with 4 bedrooms (two on the main level and two upstairs) plus a full bath on each floor. A spacious, sun-filled living room with a fireplace flows into the newer kitchen, featuring a granite island and direct access to a 3-season screened porch. Hardwood floors run throughout most of the home, adding warmth and character. Enjoy central air, a one-car attached garage, and a large finished basement with laundry, ideal for a media room, gym, or game space. Outside, the fully fenced, level backyard provides the perfect setting for relaxing, gardening, or outdoor fun. With local favorites like Blue Cactus Grill and Angelo's Specialties nearby, plus easy access to I-95, this home blends convenience with a peaceful neighborhood feel. Discover the space, style, and location you've been looking for in Norwalk.
